title: Workmanship Warranties Limits Schedule: Calibration Mileage and Installed Parts
content:
Some Workmanship Warranties plans cover a calibration fault or an installed part only within a mileage or month limit. The limits for every plan are set out below; a 0 entry means the item is not applicable or not covered under that plan, as the note to each row states.

| Limit | Chip Repair Guarantee | Calibration Workmanship Warranty | Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty | Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Miles after the odometer at issue within which a calibration fault is covered (0 means not applicable) | 0 | 12000 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Calendar months a mechanical part installed in the repair is covered (0 means not covered) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 | 24 |
| Miles after the odometer at issue within which an installed mechanical part is covered (0 means not covered) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12000 | 24000 |
| Calendar months an electrical part or sensor installed in the repair is covered (0 means not covered) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 | 24 |

## Notes to the schedule

- **Calibration mileage.** Under the Calibration Workmanship Warranty a calibration fault is covered within 12000 miles after the odometer at issue. The figure is 0, not applicable, under every other plan.
- **Mechanical parts.** A mechanical part installed in the repair is covered for 12 calendar months and within 12000 miles after the odometer at issue under the Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty, and for 24 calendar months and within 24000 miles under the Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty. Under the other four plans both figures are 0: installed mechanical parts are not covered.
- **Electrical parts and sensors.** An electrical part or sensor installed in the repair is covered for 12 calendar months under the Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty and 24 calendar months under the Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty; the figure is 0, not covered, under the other four plans.

## Hypothetical reading

A Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty was issued at a hypothetical odometer of 40000 miles. Its installed mechanical part limit runs to 12 calendar months from the issued date and to 52000 miles, which is 40000 miles plus 12000 miles. The same figures under the Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty would be 24 calendar months and 64000 miles.
